outcome: time to recovery from obstetric fistula
cohort: 289 obstetric fistula patients from the University of Gondar Teaching Hospital Fistula Center in Gondar, Ethiopia.
finding: Older age at first marriage, weight < 50 kg, height > 150 cm, attending antenatal care, delivery at a health center, labor duration < 2 days, vaginal delivery, urban residence, accessing education, fistula width < 5 cm, intact urethra, and urine incontinence duration < 3 months were significantly associated with shorter hospital stay and faster recovery from obstetric fistula.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with shorter hospital stay and faster recovery from obstetric fistula.
followup_time: Until physical cure and discharge from hospital (average 5.19 weeks)
